name: Bud & Mary's Manufacturing Facility
old_description: There’s no THC cap on Iowa Medical cannabis products, and getting a medical marijuana card is simple. Get your med card today and find a dispensary near you!
about:
Bud & Mary's Manufacturing Facility, operating as Bud & Mary's Iowa, runs medical cannabis dispensaries in Des Moines and Sioux City, Iowa. The company was founded in 2005, though Iowa's medical cannabis program was established in 2018 to serve patients with qualifying conditions. Ownership details and founders are not disclosed in public sources.

The company operates two dispensary locations where it retails state-approved medical cannabis products including concentrates, vapes, edible tablets, THC dissolvable powder, topical creams, and tinctures. In January 2025, the company launched its first live resin cannabis product in the Iowa medical market. The dispensaries serve more than 18,000 registered Iowa patients, assisting them with medical card applications and product selection.

Bud & Mary's serves medical cannabis patients across Iowa, with qualifying conditions such as chronic pain, multiple sclerosis, and other state-approved ailments. The dispensaries cater to both patients and caregivers, providing access to regulated, third-party-tested cannabis products. The company also engages in community outreach, including a $15,000 donation to Easterseals Iowa in February 2025.

The company emphasizes compliance with Iowa's regulatory framework, which imposes no THC potency cap on medical products and requires third-party verification. Its rewards program offers referral incentives for patients, and the dispensaries position themselves as access points for patients seeking alternatives to opioid-based pain management.

name: BudCo Electric
old_description: When your home or business needs reliable electrical work done right the first time, you want a licensed, local electrician who actually shows up on time and stands behind the work. From electrical panel upgrades and EV charger installation to 24-hour emergency electrical services, our licensed team handles it all, safely, cleanly, and at fair prices.
about:
BudCo Electric operates from Colorado Springs, Colorado, serving residential and commercial customers across El Paso County. The locally owned electrical contracting company has been active in the community for years, though a specific founding year is not publicly stated. Its team of licensed electricians lives and works in the same neighborhoods they serve, from older downtown districts with aging wiring to newer subdivisions in Briargate and Stetson Hills and rural properties in Black Forest and Peyton.

The company provides a full scope of electrical contracting services. Core offerings include electrical panel replacements and upgrades, subpanel installations, EV charger installation with dedicated circuits, residential wiring and rewiring for remodels and older homes, indoor lighting and ceiling fan installation, whole-home surge protection at the main panel, standby generator installation, and 24-hour emergency response for both residential and commercial clients. Commercial work covers tenant improvements, office build-outs, exterior lighting, and three-phase power upgrades. Most panel replacements are completed in a single day.

BudCo Electric serves homeowners, landlords, builders, business owners, property managers, and general contractors throughout Colorado Springs and the greater El Paso County area. The company regularly works in zip codes spanning central, east, north, and northeast Colorado Springs, as well as Black Forest, Monument, Security-Widefield, Fort Carson, Fountain, Cimarron Hills, Gleneagle, and Peyton. Military families and civilians in the Fort Carson area are noted among its clientele.

The company emphasizes doing work right the first time with no shortcuts, providing straight answers and transparent pricing before work begins, and respecting customers' homes by showing up on time, using boot covers, protecting floors and walls, and leaving job sites cleaner than they were found. It positions itself as a neighbor-first business that keeps money local and supports Colorado tradespeople.

name: Buhler Inc
old_description: Bühler Networking Days 2025: growing business, lowering footprint
about:
Buhler Inc, the U.S. subsidiary of the Bühler Group, is headquartered in Plymouth, Minnesota. The Swiss parent company was founded in 1898 and has grown into a global supplier of process technologies and equipment.

The company designs and builds processing lines for food, feed, and advanced materials. Its portfolio covers grain milling, extrusion, cocoa and chocolate processing, pasta and snack production, as well as vacuum thin‑film coating, die casting, and wet grinding for batteries, semiconductors, and optical components. Buhler also provides lifecycle services including installation, maintenance, process optimization, upgrades, and a 24/7 hotline, supported by application and training centers such as the Milling Academy.

Customers span the food and feed sectors — animal feed, aqua feed, baked goods, dairy, pet food, and confectionery — and advanced‑materials industries such as battery electrode production, semiconductor packaging, automotive glass coating, and precision optics. Automotive OEMs including Volvo and Hyundai have adopted Bühler megacasting and die‑casting systems for vehicle components.

Bühler states that its innovations aim to create a better world with a focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions, citing energy‑saving developments like the Lucent cocoa roaster that cuts energy use by at least 20 percent while raising throughput.

name: Burmeister Woodwork Co
old_description: Burmeister woodwork has been producing the finest architectural millwork since 1937
about:
Burmeister Woodwork Co. operates from Hales Corners, Wisconsin, tracing its roots to the early 1920s when Marvin Burmeister founded Advance Millwork. The company adopted its current name in 1937 and remained family-owned through three generations—George Burmeister took over in 1964, adding stair fabrication, and his son Russell shifted focus to high-end architectural millwork in 1981. In 2015, John Sprenger, a military veteran, purchased the business and now serves as president, emphasizing a culture of craftsmanship he attributes to his service experience.

The firm produces custom architectural millwork—cabinetry, stairs, moldings, doors, and related components—for luxury residential and commercial projects. A 40,000-square-foot manufacturing facility houses a team of 60 professionals who combine traditional hand craftsmanship with modern engineering, fabrication, finishing, and installation capabilities. The shop collaborates with specialty vendors to integrate custom veneers, exotic wood species, metal, glass, and upholstery into complex, technically demanding projects.

Clients span the luxury residential sector and commercial interiors across the Midwest and nationally. Representative projects include a modern bank lobby, historic stable conversion, Chicago greystone renovation, penthouse interiors, and a boat enthusiast’s dream residence, illustrating the range from contemporary urban spaces to rustic lake-country homes.

Sprenger cites the pursuit of excellence learned in the military as a driving force, and the company positions its 89-year legacy as a foundation for delivering uncompromising artisanship on each project.

name: Burton Electronics Manufacturing Services
old_description: Our team delivers precise, scalable electronics manufacturing powered by craftsmanship, accountability and pride in every assembly.
about:
Burton Electronics Manufacturing Services (Burton EMS) was founded in 1978 by Edward Leman and James Treiterer in New Berlin, Wisconsin. The family-owned company now maintains its headquarters in Hazelhurst, WI, and operates two manufacturing plants in Ironwood, MI. Operational control passed to Gary Burnett, Sr. in 1997, and the business remains family-led with Mark Leman as President & CFO and Gary Burnett Jr. as Vice President.

The contract manufacturer specializes in high-mix, low-to-medium volume electronics assembly, offering full product lifecycle support from design and engineering through production and end-market services. Capabilities include surface-mount and through-hole PCB assembly, box build, mechanical assembly, spray coating, and comprehensive testing such as burn-in and product validation. ft. Hazelhurst plant and a 20,000 sq. ft. Ironwood facility expanded in 2006–2007, with a second Ironwood site added in 2021–2022 for high-level assembly and test. The company employs lean manufacturing, 5S, and Six Sigma methodologies, and uses 3D solder paste inspection and automated optical inspection for process control.

Burton serves OEMs in medical, industrial, motor control, specialized consumer, security, building controls, defense, and professional tool markets. Customers are described as industry leaders who demand high performance and reliability, and the company emphasizes long-term partnerships with program management and customer-focused teams.

The company states its differentiation lies in a "people-driven" culture that prioritizes direct communication, teamwork, proactive problem-solving, and integrity. It cites a warranty return rate below 0.5%, on-time delivery above 97%, and first-pass yield exceeding 99% as measurable outcomes of that culture. An intelligent DFM review using VAYO software with 1,500 design rules aims to eliminate defects early.

name: Butterfield Foods LLC
old_description: Since 2011, our SQF 2000 Level 3 status has provided assurance that the products you buy from us have passed rigorous international standards for food safety and quality, including HACCP.
about:
Butterfield Foods LLC operates from Noblesville, Indiana, as a family-owned and operated custom food producer. The company emphasizes its family ownership and decades of culinary experience, though a specific founding year is not publicly stated.

The 60,000-square-foot facility is USDA inspected and holds SQF 2000 Level 3 and HACCP certifications, with on-site microbiological testing. Production capabilities include steam-jacketed kettles, steam and convection ovens, spiral freezer and nitrogen tunnels, high-speed sandwich lines, and hand assembly lines. The company offers recipe commercialization and nutritional analysis led by a Certified Research Chef, with a Culinary Institute of America graduate overseeing the kitchen team. Packaging options range from flexible pouches (2–8 lbs) to PET, CPET, or aluminum trays (10 oz–5 lbs) with modified atmosphere packaging.

Butterfield serves as a co-manufacturing partner for brands seeking custom assembly of gluten-free, halal, and kosher products such as burritos, quesadillas, sandwiches, and retail entrees. Its customer base includes food companies looking for a co-packer that can handle product development through commercial production.

The company differentiates itself through a culture of food safety and culinary integrity, targeting 100% on-time delivery and defect-free shipments. Management highlights the advantage of a medium-sized organization where clients can directly access ownership, and the R&D team works with customers at every stage from conception to execution.

name: C & C Manufacturing Inc
old_description: Since 1974 C&C Manufacturing has been producers of the Mastertrack Trailer line. Let our years of expertise help you to find your perfect trailer.
about:
C & C Manufacturing Inc. is based in Gaithersburg, Maryland. Founded in 1974, the company has produced the Mastertrack trailer line for decades.

The company manufactures trailers under the Mastertrack brand and provides a full range of trailer services including repair, maintenance, and custom fabrication. Its capabilities encompass steel and aluminum welding, brake and suspension work, body component repair, and electrical system service. C & C also operates an in-stock parts department supplying axle assemblies, hydraulic and electric brake assemblies, cargo control hardware, and tow-vehicle wiring and brake-control installation.

The company's customer base includes the U.S. Navy, the U.S. Army, and the White House, which have relied on C & C for products and industry expertise. It also serves commercial and private trailer owners through its service and parts operations.

C & C emphasizes a quality-first approach to fabrication, citing its long-standing experience as a differentiator in the trailer market.

about:
C & T Fabrication was founded in 2003 in Sparta, Michigan. The company operates as a metal fabrication shop specializing in stainless steel, laser cutting, process piping, and material handling.

The shop runs two Mazak CNC fiber‑optic lasers capable of cutting 1‑inch hot‑rolled plate and 3/4‑inch stainless plate, three Accurpress CNC brakes that bend 3/8‑inch plate up to 12 feet at 250 tons, plus a steel roller, shear, saw, drill presses, iron worker, tube bender and scissor lift. All work is performed in a 40,000‑square‑foot facility, where the team handles custom fabrication, precision laser cutting, bending, rolling, welding and engineering support.

C & T serves manufacturers, food‑processing plants, pharmaceutical companies and other industrial customers throughout West Michigan, delivering fabricated assemblies and installing them on‑site.

The firm emphasizes customer satisfaction, dependability and superior quality, citing over 30 years of combined manufacturing, design and engineering experience. It aims to build authentic relationships while providing quality products at a cost‑conscious price point.
